title: Presentation Framework And Projektetage Migration
description: Build @framework/presentation/core (declarative render-independent presentation model) + @framework/presentation/renderer/react (React+reveal.js). Migrate mit-bestand/präsentation/33.projektetage to eg-ice-25 intro (5 slides) with no direct react/reveal deps.
summary: Analyzed temp/eg-ice-25 reveal.js intro: vertical sections with data-auto-animate, participant-scoped data-id anchors, and TextMorphRoot DOM shapes (h1 title, div>h2 blocks, single h2 for short title). Core now exports morphId(), resolveTextMorphRoot(), morphRoot on text embodiments, ResolvedPlacement.morphId/embodimentId. Renderer refactored to MorphPlacementView with eg-ice DOM + joined author marks. Tests assert per-slide morph structure. Projektetage uses dark surface chrome.
